newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Parker Drilling options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Parker Drilling options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Tuesday it will list options on Parker Drilling Co on December 10.
The exchange said Parker Drilling options will have opening strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2 and initial expirations in January, February, April and July.
Parker Drilling shares were up 1/2 at 10 Tuesday afternoon.
The PHLX said Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
